interface.longDescription: An independently installable alpha package. It retains isolated Windows CI strategy bundles and adds a Current Cloud onboarding skill that may update only an empty install_script draft when the host exposes the supported draft API. It never changes startup or start_skill, publishes, approves, runs CI, or overwrites an existing install script.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $current-cloud-windows-bootstrap-alpha-onboarding only when a Cloud Current alpha install-script draft was explicitly requested. Otherwise use $github-actions-windows-bootstrap-alpha for the independent alpha Windows validation path. Do not invoke stable skills, publish, approve, run CI, or change startup/start_skill.

name: cloudcodex-windows-bootstrap-alpha
description: Independent alpha Windows Bootstrap package for Cloud Current onboarding and scoped Windows CI validation.
